card.name: Plural subject of two or more items
card.fires_on: A plural subject word such as both, these, the two drugs or parents, right after two or more items were just named. It is usually followed by a verb about them acting together or being given together.

modes.label: Both or these after named drugs
modes.description: Group words like both, these or drugs that refer back to two or more drugs just listed in an interaction statement.

card.writes: It seems to steer the model away from words like together, each or mutually, and toward other continuations after the plural subject.
card.plain: It lights up on a plural subject like 'both' or 'these drugs' when two or more things were just mentioned.
